Class InferenceEngine

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.engine.InferenceEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class InferenceEngine extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Continuous-batching inference runtime.

Fluid Injection admits work up to maxInFlight while KV pages are free. Each tick prefills (optionally chunked under a token budget), then runs a batched ModelExecutor.decodeStep(int[], int[], int[]) over all decoding requests. GenerationHandle.abort() Instant-Evicts queued and in-flight KV.

Optional idle admit coalesce (admitCoalesceMs) delays the first admission after idle so a burst can form a uniform decode cohort; admission proceeds early once queued >= maxInFlight.

When ModelExecutor.supportsStepApi() is false (test stubs), the engine falls back to serial LanguageModel.generate(int[], int, double, double, boolean, long, GenerationListener).

      public InferenceEngine(ModelExecutor executor, int maxInFlight)

    • InferenceEngine

      public InferenceEngine(ModelExecutor executor, int maxInFlight, int maxDecodeBatch, int prefillTokenBudget, long admissionTimeoutMs)
      Creates an inference engine with explicit batching budgets.
      Parameters:
      executor - model execution surface.
      maxInFlight - Fluid Injection cap.
      maxDecodeBatch - max requests in one decodeStep (<= maxInFlight).
      prefillTokenBudget - max prompt tokens prefilled per tick.
      admissionTimeoutMs - fail waiting jobs after this many ms (<= 0 = never).

    • InferenceEngine

      public InferenceEngine(ModelExecutor executor, int maxInFlight, int maxDecodeBatch, int prefillTokenBudget, long admissionTimeoutMs, long admitCoalesceMs)
      Creates an inference engine with explicit batching and admit-coalesce settings.
      Parameters:
      executor - model execution surface.
      maxInFlight - Fluid Injection cap.
      maxDecodeBatch - max requests in one decodeStep (<= maxInFlight).
      prefillTokenBudget - max prompt tokens prefilled per tick.
      admissionTimeoutMs - fail waiting jobs after this many ms (<= 0 = never).
      admitCoalesceMs - when idle, wait up to this many ms for a fuller queue before the first admit (0 = off). Stops early if queued >= maxInFlight.

    • setMaxSpeculativeConcurrency

      public void setMaxSpeculativeConcurrency(int maxSpeculativeConcurrency)
      Sets the max concurrently-decoding speculative requests before a tick falls back to plain batched decode for all speculative-flagged requests. Lower this if per-request eager draft/verify rounds cost more than the batching they give up at your measured concurrency; raise it if your workload shows speculative decoding still wins at higher concurrency.
      Parameters:
      maxSpeculativeConcurrency - max speculative concurrency (>= 1).

    • submit

      public GenerationHandle submit(GenerationRequest request, Consumer<GenerationHandle> onCreated)
      Enqueues a generation request.

      onCreated runs after the handle exists and before the job is visible to the worker (so listeners can bind requestId without racing the first decode tokens).

      Parameters:
      request - generation parameters.
      onCreated - callback with the new handle; must not block.
      Returns:
      handle with future + abort.
